title: Grammar: Two meanings of du and des
subtitle: Unit 7: Eating: déjeuner, dîner, souper

steps.title: Two meanings of du and des
steps.body: The same spelling can do two jobs. A partitive means an unspecified amount. A contraction means de + le or de + les. Use the words around it to understand the meaning.

steps.title: Tip
steps.body: Ask yourself: does du/des mean of the or some here? La carte du restaurant = of the restaurant. Je mange du fromage = some cheese.

steps.prompt: In Je mange du fromage, what does du mean?
In la carte du restaurant, what does du mean?
steps.explain: Here du joins de + le: the restaurant's menu.

steps.prompt: In Je commande des pâtes, what does des mean?
In le prix des boissons, what does des mean?
steps.explain: Here des joins de + les: the price of the drinks.
